trigger.description: The judged trigger; null for a revision the operator accepted in a chat.

decided_by.description: task: the replan task's submit; fallback: the trigger's conservative fallback, taken without a task or after the task closed lost or infeasible; operator: a revision the operator accepted in a chat, applied through the guards of a first plan at the next task boundary.

chat.description: decided_by operator only: the chat task whose proposed revision the operator accepted, and the operator's channel.

queue_task_id.description: The replan task; null for a fallback taken without a task (budget spent, no outline).

action.description: continue: a fallback that continued the plan where it stood.

rationale.description: The task's rationale; null for a fallback.

deliverables.description: The revision's deliverable changes; empty without a revision.

deadline_at.description: wait_started_at plus prerequisite_wait_seconds; a restart never extends it.

split_ref.description: split_change only: the preserved ref refs/pm-mcp/splits/<plan_id>/<n> (<n> counting the plan's splits from 1; identifiers.adoc, General Rules, Rule 7).

instance_version.description: The version of composition event replan, when the revision composed one.

outcome.description: The unit's exit; null while the unit runs.

evidence_key.description: kind-specific: the infeasible task ids, the base commit, the base commit and HEAD, HEAD and the bot, or the policy and its renewal; a checkpoint raises no trigger whose kind and key a record already carries.

checkpoint.description: The state that raised it (execute.replan-check, execute.evaluate-envelope-return, execute.exit-barrier, finalize.sync-baseline, finalize.merge-sync, finalize.review-cap-check, or the remediation call state).

phase.description: The phase value of the phase sub-workflow on the call stack of the checkpoint (store-schemas/03, Phases as Sub-Workflows).

measurement.description: The figures the condition compared: overlapping paths, conflicted files, the cap and the measured value, the spent budget.

evidence_uri.description: pm://plan/{plan_id}/evidence/{evidence_id} of the facts the task received.
